vson_p:
# Adds a Quality (color) to the apple.
# Demonstrates: hasQuality / Quality node with dimension + value.

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle eye_level :focalLength 50mm :framing close_up)
   :viewedBy cam
   :depicts (apple / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic
               :animacy Inert
               :countability Count
               :class Apple
               :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Color :value red)))
vson_t:
@prefix vso:   <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#> .
@prefix allen: <https://vson.dev/v1/allen#> .
@prefix rcc:   <https://vson.dev/v1/rcc8#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix :      <https://example.org/scenes/anonymous#> .

:scene a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Composition> .
:cam a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#CameraView> .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#angle> "eye_level" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#focalLength> "50mm" .
:cam <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framing> "close_up" .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#framedBy> :cam .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#viewedBy> :cam .
:apple a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#PhysicalObject> .
:apple <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#individuation> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Generic> .
:apple <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#animacy> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Inert> .
:apple <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#countability> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Count> .
:apple <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#class> :Apple .
:q1 a <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Quality> .
:q1 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#dimension> <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#Color> .
:q1 <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#value> :red .
:apple <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#hasQuality> :q1 .
:scene <https://vson.dev/v1/ontology#depicts> :apple .
